$comment: The template registry (single source, BR-15): every plugin-level gate — citations, template-integrity, verify-template, manifest-lint, CI — iterates over THIS list, never over hardcoded paths. Adding a template = one entry here plus the tree it names; every entry must ship a package.json with a verify script, scripts/gates-selftest.mjs, the .proto-forge pins (seed.lock, snapshot.json, config.json, config.schema.json) and docs/adr/ — manifest-lint enforces that shape. notAGate lists the entry's package.json scripts that build, serve, generate or send: each needs no register rule behind it.
